'''Ryan M. Dasso ASP-Surprise''' is a [[Light]] Portable Scanner list [[Ryan M. Dasso]] posted as a possible broken deck.<ref name="list-67547">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/67547.html? swccg-discussion message #67547], [[David Magee]] quoting [[Ryan M. Dasso]] (5 December 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990827112439/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/67547.html? Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ryan M. Dasso]]
* '''Published:''' 5 December 1998 (quoted in message 67547)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Be Mindful Of The Future|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|The Signal|JP-L-thesignal.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' ASP-Surprise
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE ASP Dasso LS 1998.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Dasso asked how to speed the Scanner stacking line.

== Strategy ==

Stack Portable Scanners on Son Of Skywalker, pass Great Warrior, then use ASP-707 to put Scanners on Reserve Deck for Surprise Assault and On The Edge.
